name: labs/oelemento__star-sim
title: Hamilton STARlet digital twin (star_sim.RobotEnv, PyLabRobot ChatterBox)
intro: Hamilton STARlet digital twin (star_sim.RobotEnv, PyLabRobot ChatterBox), adapted from oelemento/star-sim. It reads `tips_remaining_columns`; runs `transfer`, `mix` and `tracked_volumes`. `transfer`: pick up fresh tips, aspirate the source wells, dispense the target wells, discard the tips; no cleanup after a failure. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/oelemento__star-sim --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/oelemento__star-sim --backend fake --mcp
